suite: M1 Atendimento — real local API and temporary SQLite
data: Synthetic QA only; no production data or provider calls
fault_injection: One PATCH 503 and one delayed GET; remaining requests use the real API

assertions.name: desktop: only Conversas and Funil navigation; no Veículos
real empty SQLite database is usable without Coda credentials
manual creation requires only a minimum phone; optional data stays empty
optional fields and manual commercial phase persist; header updates to saved record
search locates actual stored records by name, plate and phone
detail back preserves list and search context
switching records never combines another contact or plate in the header
Chat and global/context IA stay unavailable without simulated integration
cancelling unsaved navigation keeps the form until explicit discard
injected save failure retains input and does not alter persisted data
real revision conflict preserves stale input and refuses silent overwrite
Rejeitados requires explicit refusal and reason; no automatic loss
Kanban preserves six approved labels and collapsible lanes
delayed response from another Atendimento cannot replace the active header
same SQLite records survive API stop/restart and a completely new browser session
mobile: editor scrolling/save is usable and edited data survives reload
legacy vehicle/experience URLs cannot expose operational views
no external providers, legacy Coda APIs, IA calls or uncaught page errors
